WITH DimAccount AS (
    SELECT * FROM DW.DimAccount 
    WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP', 'LNS', 'CCD', 'TRU', 'TRY') 
    AND PayrollIndicator = 'Y'
)
,DimCustomer AS (
    SELECT 
    CustomerSK,CustomerID,CustomerName
    ,CASE
        WHEN SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' AND CustomerType IN ('C','B') THEN CustomerType
        WHEN SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' AND CustomerType IN ('CC') THEN CustomerType
        WHEN SourceSystemCode = 'SEC' AND CustomerType IN ('C') THEN CustomerType
        END AS CustomerType
    ,DateOfBirth,MaritalStatus,Gender,MobileNumber,Email,AddressLine1,AddressLine2,City,Province,ZipCode,Country,DataPrivacyConsent,LastKYCDate,RiskRatingTypeSK,RiskRatingSK,SuspendedIndicator,RelationshipStartDate,PartySK,ATMEnrollmentIndicator,MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator,OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator,GenerationalCohort,PermanentCreditLimit,EmployerName,OfficeAddressLine1,OfficeAddressLine2,OfficeCity,OfficeProvince,OfficeZipCode,OfficeCountry,Industry,Occupation,BankSK,BranchSK,CurrentIndicator,ValidStartDate,ValidEndDate,SourceSystemCode,WorkFlowId,TaskRunId,InsertDttm
    FROM DW.DimCustomer
    WHERE CurrentIndicator = 'Y'
    --WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1' AND  CustomerType = 'Retail' 
)
,DimBank AS (
    SELECT * FROM DW.DimBank
    WHERE BankID IN ('CBC01', 'CBC11')
)




SELECT top 1000
DDC.CustomerId AS CustomerID
,DDC.CustomerName AS CustomerName
,DDP.PartyID AS GlobalCIF
,DDC.CustomerType AS CustomerType
,DDC.DateOfBirth AS Birthdate
,DDC.MaritalStatus AS MaritalStatus
,DDC.Gender AS Gender
,DDC.MobileNumber AS MobileNumber
,DDC.Email AS EmailAddress
,DDC.AddressLine1 AS AddressLine1
,DDC.AddressLine2 AS AddressLine2
,DDC.City AS City
,DDC.Province AS Province
,DDC.ZipCode AS ZipCode
,DDC.Country AS Country
,DDC.EmployerName AS EmployerName
,DDC.OfficeAddressLine1 AS OfficeAddressLine1
,DDC.OfficeAddressLine2 AS OfficeAddressLine2
,DDC.OfficeCity AS OfficeCity
,DDC.OfficeProvince AS OfficeProvince
,DDC.OfficeZipCode AS OfficeZipCode
,DDC.Country AS OfficeCountry
,DDC.Industry AS Industry
,DDC.Occupation AS Occupation
,MIN(DA.AccountOpenedDate) AS Tenure
,SUM(DFRB.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull) AS TotalRelationshipBalanceFULL
,SUM(DFRB.TotalRelationshipBalanceProrated) AS TotalRelationshipBalancePRORATED
,SUM(DFMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull) AS TotalMTDADBPHPDepositsFULL
,SUM(DFMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated) AS TotalMTDADBPHPDepositsPRORATED
,SUM(DFYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull) AS TotalYTDADBPHPDepositsFULL
,SUM(DFYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated) AS TotalYTDADBPHPDepositsPRORATED
,SUM(DFDB.BalanceAmountFull) AS TotalOutBalPHPDepositsFULL
,SUM(DFDB.BalanceAmountProrated) AS TotalOutBalPHPDepositPRORATED
,SUM(DFLE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull) AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoansFULL
,SUM(DFLE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated) AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoansPRORATED
,SUM(DFLB.OutstandingBalanceFull) AS TotalOutBalPHPLoansFULL
,SUM(DFLB.OutstandingBalanceProrated) AS TotalOutBalPHPLoansPRORATED
,SUM(DFLL.CreditLimitAmountFull) AS TotalCreditLimitLoansFULL
,SUM(DFLL.CreditLimitAmountProrated) AS TotalCreditLimitLoansPRORATED
,SUM(DFCE.RelationshipExposure) AS TotalOutBalPHPCards
,SUM(DFCB.StatementBalance) AS TotalOutstandingBalanceCards
,SUM(DFCL.CurrentCreditLimit) AS TotalCreditLimitCards
,SUM(DFTE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull) AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_CardsFULL
,SUM(DFTE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated) AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_CardsPRORATED
,SUM(DFP.PortfolioEndValueFull) AS TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSECFULL
,SUM(DFP.PortfolioEndValueProrated) AS TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSECPRORATED
,SUM(DFF.AUMAmountFull) AS TotalFundValueTrustFULL
,SUM(DFF.AUMAmountProrated) AS TotalFundValueTrustPRORATED
,SUM(DFI.OutstandingInvestmentFull) AS TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRYFULL
,SUM(DFI.OutstandingInvestmentProrated) AS TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRYPRORATED
,DDC.DataPrivacyConsent AS DataPrivacyConsent
,DDC.LastKYCDate AS LastKYCDate
,DDT.RiskRatingTypeName AS RiskRatingType
,DDR.RiskRatingName AS RiskRating
--,DDCA.SuspendedIndicator AS Suspended Indicator
,DDC.ATMEnrollmentIndicator AS ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator AS MBKEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator AS RIB_BOBEnrollmentIndicator
,CASE 
    WHEN DA.PayrollIndicator = 'Y' THEN DA.PayrollIndicator ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,DDC.GenerationalCohort AS GenerationalCohort
,DDMS.MarketSegmentName AS MarketSegment
,DDC.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
,DFRB.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate

FROM 
DimCustomer DDC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DDC.CustomerSK = DA.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN DimBank DDB ON DA.BankSK = DDB.BankSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimParty DDP ON DDC.PartySK = DDP.PartySK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DDCA ON DDC.CustomerSK = DDCA.CustomerSK AND DDCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK 
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance DFRB ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFRB.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD DFMTD ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFMTD.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD DFYTD ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFYTD.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance DFDB ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFDB.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure DFLE ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFLE.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance DFLB ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFLB.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactLoansCreditLimit DFLL ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFLL.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactCardsRelationshipExposure DFCE ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFCE.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance DFCB ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFCB.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactCardsCreditLimit DFCL ON DDCA.AccountSK = DDCA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure DFTE ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFTE.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactSecurityPortfolio DFP ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTrustFundValue DFF ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFF.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment DFI ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFI.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRatingType DDT ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDC.RiskRatingTypeSK) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDT.RiskRatingTypeSK)
LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRating DDR ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDC.RiskRatingSK) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDR.RiskRatingSK)
LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DDMS ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,DFRB.MarketSegmentSK) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDMS.MarketSegmentSK)


GROUP BY 
 DDC.CustomerId
,DDC.CustomerName
,DDC.CustomerType
,DDC.DateOfBirth
,DDC.MaritalStatus
,DDC.Gender
,DDC.MobileNumber
,DDC.Email
,DDC.AddressLine1
,DDC.AddressLine2
,DDC.City
,DDC.Province
,DDC.ZipCode
,DDC.Country
,DDC.EmployerName
,DDC.OfficeAddressLine1
,DDC.OfficeAddressLine2
,DDC.OfficeCity
,DDC.OfficeProvince
,DDC.OfficeZipCode
,DDC.Country
,DDC.Industry
,DDC.ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.GenerationalCohort
,DDT.RiskRatingTypeName
,DDR.RiskRatingName
,DDMS.MarketSegmentName
,DDP.PartyID
,DDC.Occupation
,DA.PayrollIndicator
--,DDR.DimRiskRatingName
--,DDT.DimRiskRatingTypeName
,DDC.LastKYCDate
,DDC.DataPrivacyConsent
--,DDCA.SuspendedIndicator
,DDC.ValidStartDate
,DFRB.BusinessDateSK
